blocks.zh: Section 2: Qualification | 確效
blocks.en: Section 2: Qualification

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解清潔確效（Cleaning Qualification）的範疇：區分設備確效（Equipment Qualification）與製程確效（Process Qualification）的各自角色，以及生命週期方法的框架。
blocks.en: Understand the scope of cleaning qualification: distinguish the respective roles of equipment qualification and process qualification, and the framework of the lifecycle approach.

blocks.zh: 掌握確效方案的必備要素：了解 Protocol Elements 包括目的、設計策略、範圍、責任、可接受標準，以及引用文件 vs. 文件納入兩種方式的差異。
blocks.en: Master the essential elements of a qualification protocol: understand that protocol elements include purpose, design strategy, scope, responsibilities and acceptance criteria, and the difference between referencing documents and incorporating them in full.

blocks.zh: 理解執行次數（Number of Runs）的決策邏輯：比較傳統三次連續執行方法與生命週期方法，以及如何提供科學依據支持不同執行次數。
blocks.en: Understand the decision logic for the number of runs: compare the traditional three consecutive runs approach with the lifecycle approach, and how to provide a scientific rationale to support different numbers of runs.

blocks.zh: 應用最差情況（Worst-Case）原則：識別常見的最差情況條件（最長髒污保留時間、最長活動期間、最短清潔時間等），並理解如何在確效方案中合理安排。
blocks.en: Apply the worst-case principle: identify common worst-case conditions (longest dirty hold time, longest campaign duration, shortest cleaning time, etc.) and understand how to build them sensibly into the protocol.

blocks.zh: 掌握設備與產品分組策略：理解分組法（Grouping）、括弧法（Bracketing）、矩陣法（Matrixing）的適用條件，以及如何選定最差情況代表品或設備。
blocks.en: Master equipment and product grouping strategies: understand when grouping, bracketing and matrixing are applicable, and how to select the worst-case representative product or equipment.

blocks.zh: 區分清潔確效（Cleaning Validation）與清潔驗證（Cleaning Verification）：了解各自的適用場景、文件要求差異，以及為何三次清潔驗證執行不等同於確效。
blocks.en: Distinguish cleaning validation from cleaning verification: understand the use cases and documentation requirements of each, and why three cleaning verification runs do not equal validation.

blocks.zh: 解讀與應用
blocks.en: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: 確效（Qualification）的兩大支柱
blocks.en: The Two Pillars of Qualification

blocks.zh: 設備確效（Equipment Qualification）：針對清潔程序所使用的設備本身，例如 CIP 清洗站（CIP Skid）或自動化零件清洗機，確認其可重複、可控地執行清潔。
blocks.en: Equipment Qualification: for the equipment used in the cleaning procedure itself, such as a CIP skid or an automated parts washer, confirming that it performs cleaning repeatably and in a controlled manner.

blocks.zh: 製程確效（Process Qualification）：重點在執行確效方案（Protocol），以連續多次執行結果來證明清潔程序的一致性。
blocks.en: Process Qualification: focuses on executing the qualification protocol, using the results of multiple consecutive runs to demonstrate the consistency of the cleaning procedure.

blocks.zh: 對於純手動清潔作業（如刷洗），可能無需設備確效活動——監管重點移轉到人員培訓與程序執行的一致性。
blocks.en: For purely manual cleaning operations (such as scrubbing), equipment qualification activities may not be needed; the regulatory focus shifts to personnel training and consistency of procedure execution.

blocks.zh: 傳統方法 vs. 生命週期方法
blocks.en: Traditional Approach vs. Lifecycle Approach

blocks.zh: 傳統方法：三次連續確效執行 = 完成確效，重點集中在方案執行本身。
blocks.en: Traditional approach: three consecutive validation runs = validation complete, with the focus on execution of the protocol itself.

blocks.zh: 生命週期方法（Lifecycle Approach）：確效執行只是全程的「中間階段」。完整生命週期包含：
blocks.en: Lifecycle approach: the validation runs are only the "middle stage" of the whole lifecycle. The complete lifecycle includes:

blocks.zh: 設計/開發階段（Design & Development）
blocks.en: Design & Development

blocks.zh: 製程確效（Process Qualification）
blocks.en: Process Qualification

blocks.zh: 持續監控/驗證維護（Ongoing Controls）
blocks.en: Ongoing Controls (continued monitoring/verification)

blocks.zh: 這與 FDA 2011 製程確效指引的精神一致，是現代 GMP 檢查的主流期望。
blocks.en: This is consistent with the spirit of the 2011 FDA Process Validation Guidance and is the mainstream expectation in modern GMP inspections.

blocks.zh: 比喻：蓋房子的結構驗收
blocks.en: Analogy: Structural Acceptance of a Building

blocks.zh: 把清潔確效想像成「房屋結構驗收」——設備確效是確認施工工具（吊車、鑽機）可正常運作；製程確效是確認實際建造流程符合設計圖規格。而生命週期方法就像加上「竣工後的定期維護與結構安全複查」，不只是一次性通過驗收就結束。
blocks.en: Think of cleaning validation as the "structural acceptance of a building": equipment qualification confirms that the construction tools (crane, drill) work properly; process qualification confirms that the actual building process meets the specifications in the design drawings. The lifecycle approach is like adding "periodic maintenance and structural safety rechecks after completion", so that passing acceptance once is not the end of the story.

blocks.zh: 確效方案要素清單（Protocol Elements Checklist）
blocks.en: Protocol Elements Checklist

blocks.zh: 目的（Purpose）：清楚說明本方案的確效目標
blocks.en: Purpose: clearly state the validation objective of the protocol

blocks.zh: 確效設計/策略（Validation Design/Strategy）：選定最差情況、分組邏輯
blocks.en: Validation Design/Strategy: selection of the worst case and the grouping logic

blocks.zh: 範圍（Scope）：涵蓋哪些設備、哪些產品、哪些清潔程序
blocks.en: Scope: which equipment, which products and which cleaning procedures are covered

blocks.zh: 責任歸屬（Responsibilities）：誰執行、誰審核、誰核准
blocks.en: Responsibilities: who executes, who reviews and who approves

blocks.zh: 適用產品與設備（Applicable Products & Equipment）
blocks.en: Applicable Products & Equipment

blocks.zh: 清潔程序（Cleaning Procedure）：引用 SOP 版本號
blocks.en: Cleaning Procedure: reference the SOP version number

blocks.zh: 可接受標準（Acceptance Criteria）：殘留限值、微生物限值
blocks.en: Acceptance Criteria: residue limits and microbial limits

blocks.zh: 人員培訓紀錄（Training）
blocks.en: Training records for personnel

blocks.zh: 最終報告要求（Final Report）
blocks.en: Final Report requirements

blocks.zh: 取樣程序（Sampling Procedures）：引用 Section 6.0
blocks.en: Sampling Procedures: reference Section 6.0

blocks.zh: 分析方法（Analytical Methods）：引用 Section 7.0
blocks.en: Analytical Methods: reference Section 7.0

blocks.zh: 殘留限值計算依據（Residue Limits）：引用 Section 5.0
blocks.en: Basis for residue limit calculation (Residue Limits): reference Section 5.0

blocks.zh: 引用文件 vs. 全文納入 — 實務選擇
blocks.en: Referencing Documents vs. Incorporating in Full: A Practical Choice

blocks.zh: 引用文件法適用於成熟系統，文件管理完善，可清楚追溯。好處是方案精簡，修改支援文件不需重新核准方案本身。
blocks.en: The referencing approach suits mature systems with well-managed documentation and clear traceability. The benefit is a lean protocol: changes to supporting documents do not require the protocol itself to be re-approved.

blocks.zh: 全文納入法適用於複雜確效活動或新清潔程序，執行者可在單一文件中找到所有必要資訊，減少執行錯誤。
blocks.en: The full incorporation approach suits complex validation activities or new cleaning procedures; the executor can find all the necessary information in a single document, reducing execution errors.

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見做法：基礎方案（Protocol）引用 SOP，但將取樣位置圖和可接受標準表格直接納入方案，兼顧精簡與清晰。
blocks.en: Common CDMO practice: the base protocol references the SOP, but the sampling location diagram and the acceptance criteria table are incorporated directly into the protocol, balancing brevity and clarity.

blocks.zh: 執行次數（Number of Runs）的決策框架
blocks.en: Decision Framework for the Number of Runs

blocks.zh: 傳統方法：三次連續執行
blocks.en: Traditional approach: three consecutive runs

blocks.zh: 長期以來，GMP 稽核員期望看到至少三次連續成功的清潔確效執行，才視為完成確效。「連續」意味著不能跳過同一清潔程序的任何清潔事件（除非有合理說明）。
blocks.en: For a long time, GMP auditors expected to see at least three consecutive successful cleaning validation runs before validation was considered complete. "Consecutive" means that no cleaning event of the same cleaning procedure may be skipped (unless there is a justified explanation).

blocks.zh: 生命週期方法：科學依據決定次數
blocks.en: Lifecycle approach: scientific rationale determines the number

blocks.zh: 基於開發階段的理解與相似製程的歷史數據，可以用科學依據支持少於或多於三次的方案設計。次數少於三次時，須提供充分的風險評估與資料支撐。
blocks.en: Based on the understanding gained in the development stage and historical data from similar processes, a scientific rationale can support a protocol design with fewer or more than three runs. When fewer than three runs are used, adequate risk assessment and supporting data must be provided.

blocks.zh: 稽核實務：三次原則仍是預設期望
blocks.en: Audit Practice: Three Runs Remains the Default Expectation

blocks.zh: 雖然 TR29 已接受生命週期方法，但在實際 FDA/EMA 稽核中，若不採用三次連續方案，仍須準備充分文件：
blocks.en: Although TR29 accepts the lifecycle approach, in actual FDA/EMA inspections, if a three consecutive run protocol is not used, adequate documentation must still be prepared:

blocks.zh: 開發階段的清潔研究資料（Development Studies Data）
blocks.en: Development Studies Data from the development stage cleaning studies

blocks.zh: 相似製程的歷史確效資料
blocks.en: Historical validation data from similar processes

blocks.zh: 風險評估（Risk Assessment）說明減少執行次數的理由
blocks.en: A Risk Assessment explaining the rationale for reducing the number of runs

blocks.zh: Manufacturing Science & Technology（MSAT）的技術評估報告
blocks.en: A technical assessment report from Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT)

blocks.zh: 若無充分依據，建議維持三次連續執行以降低監管風險。
blocks.en: Without adequate justification, it is advisable to keep three consecutive runs to reduce regulatory risk.

blocks.zh: 比喻：工程驗收次數
blocks.en: Analogy: Number of Acceptance Tests in Engineering

blocks.zh: 想像承攬商在驗收一座橋樑——傳統做法是「測試三次確保結構穩定」；而現代工程方法是「根據設計模擬數據和相似橋樑的驗收結果，決定需要幾次實體測試」。次數可多可少，關鍵是背後的科學依據。
blocks.en: Imagine a contractor having a bridge accepted: the traditional approach is "test three times to make sure the structure is stable", whereas the modern engineering approach is "decide how many physical tests are needed based on design simulation data and the acceptance results of similar bridges". The number can be more or fewer; what matters is the scientific rationale behind it.

blocks.zh: 模擬髒污（Mock Soiling）的兩個概念
blocks.en: Two Concepts of Mock Soiling

blocks.zh: Mock Soiling（模擬髒污程序）：整個模擬製造流程的動作——在商業設備上施加模擬物質，代替實際生產批次，然後執行清潔確效。
blocks.en: Mock Soiling (the mock soiling procedure): the whole simulated manufacturing sequence, in which a simulated substance is applied to commercial equipment in place of an actual production batch, and cleaning validation is then performed.

blocks.zh: Mock Soil / Surrogate Soil（代替物質）：用來模擬實際殘留物理化特性的替代物質，例如模擬某 API 在溶劑中的溶解度、黏附性等特性。
blocks.en: Mock Soil / Surrogate Soil (the substitute material): a substitute substance used to simulate the physicochemical properties of the actual residue, for example the solubility and adhesion of a given API in a solvent.

blocks.zh: 何時使用 Mock Soiling？
blocks.en: When to Use Mock Soiling?

blocks.zh: 臨床試驗用藥（Clinical Trial Materials）：批量小，難以安排三次商業批次
blocks.en: Clinical Trial Materials: small batch sizes make it difficult to schedule three commercial batches

blocks.zh: 季節性產品或低頻製造品項
blocks.en: Seasonal products or infrequently manufactured items

blocks.zh: 新設備導入期間，商業批次尚未排程
blocks.en: During the introduction of new equipment, when commercial batches have not yet been scheduled

blocks.zh: 主動成份毒性高，不希望在確效期間大量製造
blocks.en: The active ingredient is highly toxic and you do not want to manufacture large quantities during validation

blocks.zh: 監管要求：必須提供充分的科學依據，說明模擬物質如何真實模擬實際製造情況（包括濃度、接觸時間、乾燥條件等）。
blocks.en: Regulatory expectation: an adequate scientific rationale must be provided to explain how the mock material realistically simulates actual manufacturing conditions (including concentration, contact time, drying conditions, etc.).

blocks.zh: 最差情況（Worst-Case）產品選擇依據
blocks.en: Basis for Selecting the Worst-Case Product

blocks.zh: 選定最差情況產品的科學方法：
blocks.en: Scientific methods for selecting the worst-case product:

blocks.zh: 溶解度（Solubility）：API 在清潔溶液中的溶解度最低者 → 最難清潔
blocks.en: Solubility: the API with the lowest solubility in the cleaning solution is the hardest to clean

blocks.zh: 毒性/安全限值（Toxicity/ADE）：ADE 或 TTC 值最低者 → 殘留限值最嚴格
blocks.en: Toxicity/Safety Limit (Toxicity/ADE): the product with the lowest ADE or TTC value has the strictest residue limit

blocks.zh: 物理黏附性：乾燥後較難去除的劑型（如黏性膏劑、高脂質配方）
blocks.en: Physical adhesion: dosage forms that are harder to remove once dried (such as sticky ointments and high-lipid formulations)

blocks.zh: 實驗室 Coupon 研究：以代表性不鏽鋼表面進行清潔時間比較，定義相對清潔難易度（Relative Cleanability）
blocks.en: Laboratory coupon studies: compare cleaning times on representative stainless steel surfaces to define relative cleanability

blocks.zh: 比喻：洗碗的最差情況
blocks.en: Analogy: Worst Case in Dishwashing

blocks.zh: 想像你要確效一款自動洗碗機：最差情況是「最油膩的餐盤」（最難清潔的產品）、「放最久沒洗的狀態」（最長髒污保留時間）、加上「水溫設到允許範圍下限」（最低溫度）。如果在這些最差條件下洗乾淨，其他情況一定也沒問題。
blocks.en: Imagine validating an automatic dishwasher: the worst case is the "greasiest plate" (the product that is hardest to clean), "left unwashed the longest" (longest dirty hold time), combined with "water temperature set at the lower limit of the allowed range" (lowest temperature). If it cleans successfully under these worst-case conditions, other situations will certainly be fine too.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 1
blocks.en: Exercise 1

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 生產三種藥品（API 溶解度：A = 10 mg/mL、B = 0.5 mg/mL、C = 50 mg/mL），使用同一套設備，以同一 CIP 程序清潔。
blocks.en: A CDMO manufactures three drug products (API solubility: A = 10 mg/mL, B = 0.5 mg/mL, C = 50 mg/mL), using the same equipment, cleaned with the same CIP procedure.

blocks.zh: 問題：若要選定最差情況（Worst-Case）產品進行清潔確效，應選擇哪個產品？為什麼？
blocks.en: Question: If you are to select the worst-case product for cleaning validation, which product should you choose? Why?

blocks.zh: 提示：思考溶解度與清潔難易度的關係，以及「最難清潔」的定義。
blocks.en: Hint: think about the relationship between solubility and ease of cleaning, and the definition of "hardest to clean".

blocks.zh: 產品放行 vs. 設備放行 — 邏輯鏈
blocks.en: Product Release vs. Equipment Release: The Logic Chain

blocks.zh: TR29 確立了一個關鍵邏輯：
blocks.en: TR29 establishes a key logic:

blocks.zh: 已清潔前批產品：其放行決定基於「自身的品質檢驗數據」，與後續清潔確效結果無關。（清潔只影響下一批，不影響被清潔的前批產品）
blocks.en: The previously manufactured batch that has been cleaned out: its release decision is based on its "own quality test data" and is independent of the subsequent cleaning validation results. (Cleaning only affects the next batch, not the previous batch that was just cleaned out.)

blocks.zh: 清潔後的設備放行：須基於「本次確效取樣的殘留分析結果」
blocks.en: Release of equipment after cleaning: must be based on "the residue analysis results from this validation sampling"

blocks.zh: 使用已清潔設備製造的下一批產品：須等到確效數據達標才能放行
blocks.en: The next product batch manufactured with the cleaned equipment: can be released only after the validation data meet the acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 兩種設備放行方式的風險比較
blocks.en: Risk Comparison of the Two Equipment Release Approaches

blocks.zh: 方式一：等數據再放行 — 保守做法，生產排程可能延誤，但無需回溯評估。適合高風險或高毒性產品。
blocks.en: Approach 1: wait for the data before release - a conservative approach; production scheduling may be delayed, but no retrospective assessment is needed. Suitable for high-risk or highly toxic products.

blocks.zh: 方式二：「風險自負」放行 — 生產效率較高，但若數據不符合，須進行偏差調查（Deviation Investigation）並評估下一批產品的影響，可能涉及召回風險。
blocks.en: Approach 2: release "at risk" - higher production efficiency, but if the data do not meet the criteria, a deviation investigation is required and the impact on the next product batch must be assessed, which may involve recall risk.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務建議：初次確效或新產品，採方式一；已有成熟清潔數據的常規製造，可考慮方式二，但需有完整的風險評估支持。
blocks.en: CDMO practical recommendation: use Approach 1 for initial validation or new products; for routine manufacturing with established cleaning data, Approach 2 may be considered, but it must be supported by a complete risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 分組策略的三個核心概念
blocks.en: Three Core Concepts of Grouping Strategy

blocks.zh: Equipment Grouping（設備分組）：將設計相似、操作模式相似、清潔難易度相似的設備歸為一組，只對代表性設備進行完整確效。
blocks.en: Equipment Grouping: group equipment with similar design, similar operating mode and similar ease of cleaning, and perform full validation only on representative equipment.

blocks.zh: Bracketing（括弧法）：選取組內「極端值」代表——例如最大和最小的儲槽，用以涵蓋整個尺寸範圍，不需對每種尺寸都確效。
blocks.en: Bracketing: select the "extreme" representatives within the group, for example the largest and smallest tanks, to cover the whole size range without validating every size.

blocks.zh: Matrixing（矩陣法）：系統性安排，使每種組合都被部分確效覆蓋，整體優化確效工作量。適用於多產品、多設備的複雜矩陣情境。
blocks.en: Matrixing: a systematic arrangement so that every combination is covered by partial validation, optimizing the overall validation workload. Applicable to complex scenarios with multiple products and multiple pieces of equipment.

blocks.zh: 產品分組最差情況選定流程
blocks.en: Process for Selecting the Worst Case in Product Grouping

blocks.zh: 收集所有待分組產品的 API 溶解度、ADE 值、劑型特性
blocks.en: Collect the API solubility, ADE values and dosage form characteristics of all products to be grouped

blocks.zh: 實驗室 Coupon 研究：比較各產品在相同清潔條件下的清潔時間
blocks.en: Laboratory coupon studies: compare the cleaning time of each product under the same cleaning conditions

blocks.zh: 定義相對清潔難易度 + 考量最嚴格殘留限值 → 選定 Worst-Case 產品
blocks.en: Define relative cleanability + consider the strictest residue limit → select the Worst-Case product

blocks.zh: 注意：若 ADE 最低的產品（殘留限值最嚴格）與最難清潔的產品不同，應考慮對兩者都進行完整確效方案。
blocks.en: Note: if the product with the lowest ADE (strictest residue limit) differs from the hardest-to-clean product, consider performing a full validation protocol on both.

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車型號認證
blocks.en: Analogy: Car Model Certification

blocks.zh: 括弧法（Bracketing）就像汽車安全碰撞測試——不需測試同款車型的每種顏色，只要測試最大尺寸和最小尺寸的版本，其他尺寸因為在「括弧範圍內」而被視為已涵蓋。設備分組也是同樣邏輯：測試最複雜的和最簡單的，中間的自動涵蓋。
blocks.en: Bracketing is like a car safety crash test: you do not need to test every color of the same model, only the largest and smallest versions; other sizes are considered covered because they fall "within the bracket". Equipment grouping follows the same logic: test the most complex and the simplest, and those in between are automatically covered.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 2
blocks.en: Exercise 2

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 有五個儲存槽用於同一清潔 SOP：容量分別為 100L、250L、500L、1000L、2000L，設計相似但尺寸不同。
blocks.en: A CDMO has five storage tanks that use the same cleaning SOP: capacities of 100 L, 250 L, 500 L, 1000 L and 2000 L, with similar design but different sizes.

blocks.zh: 問題：若採用括弧法（Bracketing），應選擇哪些儲槽進行完整確效方案？原因為何？若 250L 槽內部有額外的攪拌葉片（其他槽沒有），應如何處理？
blocks.en: Question: If bracketing is used, which tanks should be selected for the full validation protocol, and why? If the 250 L tank has additional agitator blades inside (the others do not), how should this be handled?

blocks.zh: 提示：思考「最大與最小代表極端值」的邏輯，以及複雜結構如何影響設備分組的歸類。
blocks.en: Hint: think about the logic of "the largest and smallest represent the extremes", and how a complex structure affects equipment grouping.

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：三次驗證不等於確效
blocks.en: Important Reminder: Three Verifications Do Not Equal Validation

blocks.zh: TR29 明確指出：即使執行了三次清潔驗證（Cleaning Verification），在缺乏適當設計與開發基礎的情況下，不能視為清潔確效（Cleaning Validation）。
blocks.en: TR29 states clearly that even if three cleaning verification runs are performed, in the absence of an appropriate design and development basis they cannot be regarded as cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: 確效的本質在於：透過系統性的設計開發，建立對清潔程序的科學理解，再以有計畫的確效執行來證明這種理解是正確的。沒有開發基礎的重複執行，只是重複確認單次事件，不具有推論至未來批次的確效效力。
blocks.en: The essence of validation is to build a scientific understanding of the cleaning procedure through systematic design and development, and then use a planned validation execution to prove that this understanding is correct. Repeated runs without a development basis merely re-confirm a single event and carry no validation power to support inference to future batches.

blocks.zh: 比喻：食譜 vs. 即興料理
blocks.en: Analogy: Recipe vs. Improvised Cooking

blocks.zh: 清潔確效就像有完整食譜（開發階段）加上多次試作記錄——證明這道料理在不同廚師手中都能穩定重現。清潔驗證則像一次即興料理——做出來了，但不能保證下次也一樣。即使即興做了三次，也不等同於有了可重複執行的食譜。
blocks.en: Cleaning validation is like having a complete recipe (the development stage) plus records of multiple trial cooks, proving that the dish can be reproduced consistently in the hands of different cooks. Cleaning verification is like an improvised dish: it turned out fine, but there is no guarantee it will be the same next time. Even if you improvise three times, that is not the same as having a repeatable recipe.
